metadata.description: The product judgment Ravi Teja Palanki uses to ship AI, written down and version controlled. 90 skills (an always-on orchestrator, 67 AI PM skills across 7 specialist layers, 22 general-purpose) and 11 slash commands. AI product management is where the depth sits; the same discipline works on any question. Check the evidence first, say so when the direction is wrong, and end with the action rather than the summary.
